chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Hafs ibn Aasim, from Sayf al-Tammari, from Abu al-Murhaf, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The dust [of defeat/humiliation] is upon the one who raises it. Destroyed are the al-Mahadhir (the hasty ones). I said, 'May I be sacrificed for you, and who are the al-Mahadhir?' He said, 'The hasty ones. Indeed, they will not want anyone except the one who duels with them.' Then he said, 'O Abu al-Murhaf, indeed if they want to afflict you with a calamity, Allah, Exalted and Majestic, will present them with a distraction.' Then Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) tapped the ground with his finger and said, 'O Abu al-Murhaf!' I said, 'Here I am (at your service)!' He said, 'Do you see a people who have restricted themselves for the sake of Allah, Exalted is His mention, that Allah will not make a way out for them? Yes, by Allah, Allah will surely make a way out for them.'

key_terms.الْمَحَاضِيرُ: The hasty ones; those who rush to meet their enemies or opponents.
key_terms.حَبَسُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ: To restrict or dedicate oneself (to God's service).
key_terms.فَرَجاً: A way out, relief, or deliverance from distress.

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'Mahadhir' and what is the promise for those who restrict themselves to Allah?

en.hubeali: H 14859 – A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Hafs Bin Aasim, from Sayf Al-tammaar, from Abu Al-Murhaf, who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’farasws said:

The dust will be upon the one who raises it. Destroyed are the ‘الْمَحَاضِيرُ’ Mahazeyr!’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws, and who are the Mahazeyr?’ Heasws said: ‘The hasty ones. But, they do not want anyone except for the one who duels with them’. Then (Imamasws) said: ‘O Abu Al-Murhaf, if they want you to suffer a calamity, Allahazwj will Grab them by some kind of entanglement’. Then Abu Ja’farasws tapped on the ground, then said: ‘O Abu Al-Murhaf!’ I said, ‘Here I am (to obey)!’ Heasws said: ‘Do you see a people who have restricted themselves for the sake of Allahazwj that Heazwj will not Make a way out for them? Yes, by Allahazwj, Heazwj will (always) Make a way out for them’.
en.sarwar: 412. A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Hafs Bin Aasim, from Sayf Al-tammaar, from Abu Al-Murhaf, who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’far (a.s.) said:

The dust will be upon the one who raises it. Destroyed are the ‘الْمَحَاضِيرُ’ Mahazeyr!’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you (a.s.), and who are the Mahazeyr?’ He (a.s.) said: ‘The hasty ones. But, they do not want anyone except for the one who duels with them’. Then (Imam (a.s.)) said: ‘O Abu Al-Murhaf, if they want you to suffer a calamity, Allah (azwj) will Grab them by some kind of entanglement’. Then Abu Ja’far (a.s.) tapped on the ground, then said: ‘O Abu Al-Murhaf!’ I said, ‘Here I am (to obey)!’ He (a.s.) said: ‘Do you see a people who have restricted themselves for the sake of Allah (azwj) that He (azwj) will not Make a way out for them? Yes, by Allah (azwj), He (azwj) will (always) Make a way out for them’.
